title: Grilled Shrimp Skewers with Crunchy Slaw
description: A flavorful and colorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring succulent shrimp skewers served with a refreshing crunchy slaw.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together portuguese, quick, salt, and pepper.
3. Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat.
4. Thread the shrimp onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
5. Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
6. Meanwhile, combine the crunchy in a separate bowl.
7. Serve the grilled shrimp skewers with the crunchy slaw on top.
8. Garnish with fresh cilantro and lime wedges, if desired.
